events.verdict: Although Conley (MIN) trips over his teammate McDaniels' (MIN) foot, Allen (PHX) initiates the illegal contact during the exchange when he pushes him to create space.
Plumlee (PHX) places a forearm against McDaniels' (MIN body to brace for the ensuing contact and it does not affect McDaniels' dunk attempt.
Allen's (PHX) shot attempt goes directly out of bounds without touching another player. Possession is correctly awarded to the Timberwolves.
O'Neale (PHX) firms up in a screening position in McDaniels' (MIN) path and does not deliver contact as they come together.
Gobert (MIN) reaches for the ball as Booker (PHX) brings his own arm upwards and the contact between the two players is marginal.
Conley (MIN) legally contests Allen's (PHX) jump shot attempt. Any follow-through contact to Allen's front as he returns to the ground is marginal.
Plumlee (PHX) initiates illegal contact with Edwards' (MIN) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Allen (PHX) establishes himself in Alexander-Walker's (MIN) path and absorbs the contact during the screen.
Okogie (PHX) firms up in a screening position in Alexader-Walker's (MIN) path and does not deliver contact.
Nurkic (PHX) continues moving into McDaniels (MIN) after the initial contact during the screen, delaying him from contesting the jump shot attempt.
Edwards (MIN) and Allen (PHX) reach for the rebound and the contact between the two players is incidental.
Jones (PHX) makes clean contact with the ball as he pursues the rebound and any contact from Gobert is marginal. The ball remains in bounds after Jones throws it off of Gobert's body.
Edwards (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends Booker (PHX) on the perimeter. Booker briefly grasps Edwards' extended arm, but the contact is marginal.
McDaniels (MIN) legally contests Booker's (PHX) driving shot attempt. Any follow-through contact as Booker returns to the floor is incidental.
Booker's (PHX) shot attempt does not touch the rim and the shot clock expires prior to Alexander-Walker (MIN) gaining full control of the rebound.
Randle (MIN) lifts his pivot foot prior to releasing his dribble.

Randle (MIN) places his off-arm against Okogie (PHX) and releases from contact as he steps back into his shot attempt. Okogie is not dislodged from his defensive position as a result of illegal contact from Randle.
